use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

evidence_cards.content: IFF/SIF data (Modes I, II, and III Codes) are transmitted in the J3.1 and J3.5 (PTI = 0) messages when available.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific objective of transmitting transponder data via designated message types, directly addressing the 'Exchange' aspect of the use case goal.

evidence_cards.content: The goal of the use case is to report IFF/SIF surveillance data (specifically in J3.2C1 and J3.3C1 words) for Air and Surface tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly defines the objective of the interaction regarding IFF/SIF data reporting, which corresponds to the 'goal' slot.

evidence_cards.content: Each JU without R² shall compare locally held data with IFF/SIF data reported by the JU with R² and report any valid data that are different.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This statement defines the high-level objective of the use case for the primary actor (JU without R²) regarding IFF/SIF difference resolution.
